articles.summary: Central Pacific Bank (CPB) and the Patsy T. Mink Center for Business and Leadership are proud to introduce the 2026 cohort for the WE by CPB Rising Tide program. Marking its sixth year of driving local economic growth, the program has selected 20 outstanding women entrepreneurs from across Hawaii—including seven businesses from Hawaii Island—equipping them with the strategic tools, resources, and networking opportunities to grow their operations.
articles.title: Central Pacific Bank and Patsy T. Mink Center Announce 2026 Class of We by CPB Rising Tide Program
